## About
We started with a group of friends who met at Universal Studios' Halloween Horror Nights and wanted to open an escape room of our own. We're a small family-run business, and we're escape room enthusiasts at heart.
Our rooms share one interconnected story world built around the notorious Tillman family. The puzzles are part of the room itself, so it feels like you're living it. Figuring out how the rooms connect is just as thrilling as getting out.
Halloween is at the heart of it all. Sit in our newly-refurbished lobby with its pumpkin patch, fall air and treats, and you'll see why we say it's Halloween every day of the year. Guests have rated us 4.9 from 2256 Google reviews.

## Services
- Asylum: Investigate the asylum before the malicious spirits trap you in the abandoned halls. One reviewer called it jump scare heavy, and another suggests starting here to follow the story in order.
- The Ringmaster: Elude the ringmaster before you become part of his freak show. One reviewer found it eerie but not scary, and great for groups that like to work on multiple things at the same time.
- At The Hop Ice Cream Shop: Step back in time and discover the secret family recipe. One family called it family friendly, with creative puzzles and incredible atmosphere.
- The Video Store: Test your luck in the world of movie magic and race the clock to win the video store owner's inheritance. One reviewer said it's fun for everyone.
- Cinema 7: Enter the seventh room and face your fears. One reviewer praised the perfectly timed jump scares, and another said its set design was the best they had seen in the Orlando area.
- Camp Harvest Moon: Our new game. Decipher the clues and outsmart the rival cabin before lights out. One family said they spent their time laughing.
- The Archive: A challenging room for groups who want to really work together, with set design one reviewer called top notch. You will need someone who can climb stairs and crawl.
- Team building: A fun way for companies, Scout leaders, youth groups and teachers to get people communicating, thinking outside the box and solving problems together.

## FAQ
Q: Are all of your rooms scary?
A: No. We offer family-friendly escape rooms, and we can customize any of our rooms for the faint of heart. Talk to your game master about your group's needs.

Q: Will we be playing with strangers?
A: No. All of our games are private, so it's just your group in the room.

Q: Which room should we play first?
A: One reviewer suggests starting with Asylum if you want to follow the story of all our rooms in order.

Q: Should we book ahead?
A: Yes. Our games fill up quickly, so if you have a specific date in mind, make your reservation as soon as you can.

Q: Can you bring a game to our event?
A: Yes. Our pop-up escape game Happily Never After can be booked for your special event or function.

## What customers say
- "My family and I were in Florida for the week and were looking for something to do. Dare 2 Escape was nearby and, being escape room enthusiasts, we were very excited by the rooms they offered.

We played 5 of their escape rooms and every single one was amazing! Ruth was our first game master and was very sweet and helpful. Dani was our game master for the rest of our rooms and she was INCREDIBLE!! She was clear and helpful when we needed help and accommodating to our play style of, frankly, being a little stubborn with clues but also needing a nudge every once in a while haha!

At The Hop Ice Cream Shop — This room was our first and it was well designed with creative puzzles and incredible atmosphere. Family Friendly, great for groups with different types of mindsets to work together.

The Ringmaster — My personal favorite, The Ringmaster was intuitive and atmospheric. This room is great for groups that like to work on multiple things at the same time. Eerie but not scary, comfortable seating if needed, great use of the space it has.

The Video Store — This room is fun for everyone! Our group got stuck at the beginning but with some help from Dani, we managed to get through. Very immersive, family friendly, creative puzzles.

Camp Harvest Moon: Prank Wars ‘92 — This room was just a fun time all around! We spent most of our time laughing. This room is great for groups looking for a laid back room to have an all around good time. Family friendly, great music, fun decorations and atmosphere, space to sit if needed.

The Archive — This room was the most challenging for our group but I LOVED it! The room was incredibly well designed and made the most of their space. This room is great for groups who are looking to really work together to solve puzzles. There are points where you need to solve multiple things at the same time. I would recommend at least 4 people for this room. Eerie but not scary, might be difficult for those with mobility issues and you will need someone who can climb stairs and crawl, challenging but immersive puzzles.

Bathrooms and lobby were also well kept and cleanly. I love Dare 2 Escape and I hope we can come back at some point to finish their other rooms!" (Lundan Lane, 5/5)
- "My team and I did Asylum and Ringmaster this evening and we had a blast! Mika was our game host, and she made sure that we had plenty of fun jump scares during our play throughs! If you want to follow the chronological order of the through story of all of Dare2Escape’s rooms, then you should start with Asylum.

Asylum has an interesting story and really nice set design. It is one of the oldest rooms (if not the oldest room) here, but I think it has aged well. Interesting puzzles and some creepy moments. It is fairly linear so I would not take a large group into this room as some people will have little to nothing to do.

Ringmaster is another solid room. Due to the sheer number of puzzles, the room is less linear. The story was again interesting and more than a little disturbing. I cannot wait to see where the Dare2Escape lore goes next. Be warned though, this room will be closing some time in the near future. There isn’t a closing date yet, but if you are interested in playing it do not wait!

*update* We played through Camp Harvest Moon and The Archive. Camp Harvest Moon was nothing mind blowing, but as kids of the 90’s we loved the nostalgia of the room! As for The Archive, I wish I could love this room, but I just can’t. First off, the set design is top notch. One of the best designs in the Orlando area that I have seen, only outdone by Cinema 7 in my opinion.  The story is awesome. I love the Tillman lore and this story does not disappoint on that front. My main issue is the gameplay. Over-thinkers beware. There was one puzzle in particular that we wasted a ton of time on simply because I read too much into a particular written instruction I was given. One of the last few puzzles was also very frustrating in the its implementation. So, yes, this one is a mixed bag. I loved aspects of it and was disappointed by others.

Can’t wait to come back again and see where the Dare2Escape story takes us!" (Rachel Harris, 5/5)

We’ve been coming here for the past four years whenever we visit Orlando from Seattle, and we absolutely LOVE it! The rooms are so thoughtfully designed, creative, and incredibly well executed. You can tell so much care goes into every detail!

And the STAFF!!! Dani and Mandy, our Room Masters, OMG! What can we say? You two are THE BEST!! ❤️ You always make the experience even more amazing. And Brittany is newer to the team but is already doing a kick-ass job! We love you all!!

Dare 2 Escape is always a must-do for us whenever we’re in Orlando. We can’t recommend this place enough! If you love escape rooms, you NEED to check this place out!" (Karen McGee, 5/5)
